div.l: From burdeux ward whil that the chapman slep
Of nyce consience tok he none kep
Ȝif that he fauȝt ⁊and hadde the heyere hand
Be watyr he sente hēm hom by eủery land
But of hese craft to rekene wel hese tydis
Hese stremys ⁊and hese daıı̄ungerys hȳm besyde
His herberwe ⁊and hese mone hiˢ hi his lodmȳngage
There nas non swich frōm hul to cartage
Hardy he was ⁊and wys to vndirtake
With manye a tēmpest hadde his berd ben schake
He knew alle þe hauenys as þey were
Fro gotlond to the kape of fenystere
And eủery Cryk in bretayne ⁊and in spayne
His barge clepid was demaudelayne
With vs þ̉ere was a doctoᵘur of phisikDoctor de physik
In al þis world was ther non hȳm lik
To speke of phisik ⁊and of surgerye
For he was groıı̄undit in astronomye
Hepte hese pacient a ful gret del
In houres by his Magik naturel
Wel couthe he fortwnēn the ascendent
Of hese ymagis / for hese pacient
He knew the cause of eủery maladye
Were it hot or cold or moyst or dreye
And where þey engendere ⁊and of what humoʳur
He was averay parfyt praktysour
The cause I knowe ⁊and of hese harm the rote
Anon he ȝaf the seke man hese bote
Ful redy hadde he sese apotecaryis
To syndyn hȳm hese droggis ⁊and hese letewaryis
For eche of hēm made oþ̉ere for to wynne
Here frenschepe was not newe to begȳnne
Wel knew he the olde exculapijs
And diascorides ⁊and ek Rufijs
Olde ypocras lylye ⁊and galien
Serapion Raȝis ⁊and Auycen
